test_title: PYST 199: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 25th Nov, 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: A profit of 12% was made by selling a television for Rs. 8,820. If the television is sold at a loss of 24%, then what will be its selling price?
solution:
Let us consider Cost price of television (X) = 100%.

Given Television is sold at Rs. 8,820 at a profit of 12%.

⇒ 112% = 8,820/-

⇒ 1% = 8,820/112

⇒ 1% = 78.75/-
